name: ring-strip
title: Long Reach
premise: Roosevelt, bursting with energy, challenges patient young Lincoln to a friendly wrestling match in the ring; Lincoln wins it without seeming to do anything at all

panels.alt: Panel 1. roosevelt: "Lincoln! A bully morning for a friendly bout!"; lincoln: "Morning, Theodore."
panels.svg: <svg class="lettering" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 900" role="group" aria-label="lettering"><g class="balloon shout" data-who="roosevelt"><g fill="#1c1917" stroke="#1c1917" stroke-width="12.1" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="84.1" y="148.4" width="297.8" height="165.5" rx="76.1"/><polygon points="209.0,270.9 220.8,324.6 232.5,274.0"/></g><g fill="#fffdf8"><rect x="84.1" y="148.4" width="297.8" height="165.5" rx="76.1"/><polygon points="209.0,270.9 220.8,324.6 232.5,274.0"/></g><text x="233.0" y="200.2" font-size="36.9" text-anchor="middle">Lincoln! A bully</text><text x="233.0" y="243.0" font-size="36.9" text-anchor="middle">morning for a</text><text x="233.0" y="285.8" font-size="36.9" text-anchor="middle">friendly bout!</text></g><g class="balloon say" data-who="lincoln"><g fill="#1c1917" stroke="#1c1917" stroke-width="8.1" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="501.9" y="180.5" width="183.8" height="107.6" rx="49.5"/><polygon points="642.9,269.5 678.5,296.6 655.2,252.8"/></g><g fill="#fffdf8"><rect x="501.9" y="180.5" width="183.8" height="107.6" rx="49.5"/><polygon points="642.9,269.5 678.5,296.6 655.2,252.8"/></g><text x="593.8" y="225.9" font-size="32.4" text-anchor="middle">Morning,</text><text x="593.8" y="263.5" font-size="32.4" text-anchor="middle">Theodore.</text></g></svg>

panels.alt: Panel 2. roosevelt: "I've boxed, ranched, rowed and climbed! Brace yourself!"; lincoln: "I'll try my best to stand here."
panels.svg: <svg class="lettering" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 900" role="group" aria-label="lettering"><g class="balloon say" data-who="roosevelt"><g fill="#1c1917" stroke="#1c1917" stroke-width="8.1" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="19.8" y="276.9" width="328.2" height="145.2" rx="66.8"/><polygon points="166.7,385.0 177.1,432.1 187.4,386.7"/></g><g fill="#fffdf8"><rect x="19.8" y="276.9" width="328.2" height="145.2" rx="66.8"/><polygon points="166.7,385.0 177.1,432.1 187.4,386.7"/></g><text x="183.9" y="322.3" font-size="32.4" text-anchor="middle">I've boxed, ranched,</text><text x="183.9" y="359.9" font-size="32.4" text-anchor="middle">rowed and climbed!</text><text x="183.9" y="397.5" font-size="32.4" text-anchor="middle">Brace yourself!</text></g><g class="balloon say" data-who="lincoln"><g fill="#1c1917" stroke="#1c1917" stroke-width="8.1" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="469.8" y="276.9" width="231.7" height="145.2" rx="66.8"/><polygon points="654.1,373.4 712.3,363.1 656.3,352.8"/></g><g fill="#fffdf8"><rect x="469.8" y="276.9" width="231.7" height="145.2" rx="66.8"/><polygon points="654.1,373.4 712.3,363.1 656.3,352.8"/></g><text x="585.6" y="322.3" font-size="32.4" text-anchor="middle">I'll try my</text><text x="585.6" y="359.9" font-size="32.4" text-anchor="middle">best to stand</text><text x="585.6" y="397.5" font-size="32.4" text-anchor="middle">here.</text></g></svg>

panels.alt: Panel 3. roosevelt: "Your arms... just... keep... going!"; lincoln: "Take your time.". SHOVE
panels.svg: <svg class="lettering" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 900" role="group" aria-label="lettering"><g class="balloon shout" data-who="roosevelt"><g fill="#1c1917" stroke="#1c1917" stroke-width="12.1" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="51.9" y="244.8" width="242.0" height="165.5" rx="76.1"/><polygon points="161.7,369.0 173.5,428.5 185.3,368.8"/></g><g fill="#fffdf8"><rect x="51.9" y="244.8" width="242.0" height="165.5" rx="76.1"/><polygon points="161.7,369.0 173.5,428.5 185.3,368.8"/></g><text x="172.9" y="296.6" font-size="36.9" text-anchor="middle">Your arms...</text><text x="172.9" y="339.4" font-size="36.9" text-anchor="middle">just... keep...</text><text x="172.9" y="382.2" font-size="36.9" text-anchor="middle">going!</text></g><g class="balloon say" data-who="lincoln"><g fill="#1c1917" stroke="#1c1917" stroke-width="8.1" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="630.5" y="212.7" width="186.7" height="107.6" rx="49.5"/><polygon points="721.7,294.6 732.0,330.2 742.3,292.0"/></g><g fill="#fffdf8"><rect x="630.5" y="212.7" width="186.7" height="107.6" rx="49.5"/><polygon points="721.7,294.6 732.0,330.2 742.3,292.0"/></g><text x="723.9" y="258.1" font-size="32.4" text-anchor="middle">Take your</text><text x="723.9" y="295.7" font-size="32.4" text-anchor="middle">time.</text></g><text class="sfx" x="741.7" y="838.4" font-size="103.5" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-8 741.7 803.2)" fill="#ffd23f" stroke="#1c1917" stroke-width="8.9" paint-order="stroke" stroke-linejoin="round">SHOVE</text></svg>

panels.alt: Panel 4. Forty minutes later.. roosevelt: "Bully... I concede... Rematch tomorrow?"; lincoln: "I'll be right here. Same spot."
